body: Re-checked the F10 debug scene (Meadow/Hills/Swamp side-by-side patches) after the playtest-fix session bumped TERRAIN_TEST_CELL_SIZE 1.0->3.0 -- the spacing formula (terrain_test_offset_x) was updated at the time to scale with the same constant, but never re-screenshotted since. Confirmed via Xvfb: Meadow and Hills patches render cleanly separated with a clear gap, no overlap at the new scale. No regression, no source changes -- pure verification.
title: Verified F10 debug patches don't overlap at the new 3x scale
